The fix is complete. Summary:

**Root cause**: In `hooks/src/index.js`, the `shouldComponentUpdate` Preact installs for hook components bailed out of rendering whenever all queued state hooks ended up equal to their prior values — even when the component's props had changed on that same render. That's exactly the "set state then undo it on the same tick while also receiving a new prop" scenario.

**Fix** (hooks/src/index.js:241): when no state hook actually changed, fall back to comparing props instead of unconditionally returning `false`:

```js
return shouldUpdate
    ? prevScu
        ? prevScu.call(this, p, s, c)
        : true
    : this.props !== p;
```
